motive.zhHans: 这样做是为了让电车到站时梯子倒下、造成事故。由于 5:40 时轨道上还有另一班电车，钢丝必须在那之后才能架设。
motive.en: This was so that the ladder would tip when the train arrived and cause the accident. Because there had been another train on the tracks earlier at 5:40, the wire had to be set up after that.

method.zhHans: 她动了 Kawasaki 用来拍摄列车正面照的梯子，制造事故，以掩盖自己用钝器行凶的谋杀。梯子事先被装好，上面系着钩子，钩子连着横跨轨道的钢琴钢丝。由于 5:40 时轨道上还有另一班电车，钢丝必须在那之后才能架设。
method.en: She tampered with the ladder Kawasaki was using to take the head on picture of the train to create an accident that would disguise her bludgeoning murder. The ladder was set up beforehand with a hook attached to piano wire spanning over the tracks. Because there had been another train on the tracks earlier at 5:40, the wire had to be set up after that.

evidence.zhHans: 证据是她手腕和手掌上的伤。
evidence.en: The proof is the injuries to her wrist and palm.

summary.en: Conan and the Detective Boys wake up at 5:30 am in the morning to go get in line for a roller coaster ride in Beika Land. There are only three other people on the train at that time, and they plan on going there in order to take pictures of the train. One of the photographers waits outside so he can take pictures of the train coming towards him. Suddenly, the ladder underneath him tips over and he falls onto the track.

victims.name: Masao Horii
victims.causeOfDeath: Blunt force trauma to the head

suspects: Tetsuya Kawasaki, Rumi Shimizu, and the driver
suspectsZh: 川崎哲也、清水留美与司机
